concepts.name: 터미널 게이트
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: standalone desktop app icon concept for Passport, a personal SSH/SFTP/FTP client for macOS and Windows.
Style: polished contemporary desktop app icon, crisp minimal geometric symbol, strong silhouette at 24 and 32 pixels, restrained depth and precise edges, no illustration scene.
Composition: exactly one centered complete app icon, straight-on orthographic view, square image. The rounded square tile occupies about 86% of the canvas with consistent breathing room. A genuinely transparent background outside the tile. Symbol occupies roughly 58% of tile width. Balanced optical alignment.
Brand palette: charcoal #191E25, mint #65DDB7, off-white #E6EDF3. Use these coherently, with subtle material shading only if helpful.
Constraints: original design, no existing product logo, no wordmark, no captions, no concept number, no mockup device, no tiny details, no drop shadows extending far beyond the tile. The only permitted letter or punctuation is explicitly specified below.
Primary request: a charcoal rounded square with a bold mint terminal prompt glyph. Design the > chevron and short underscore as one balanced gateway-like composition, using thick deliberate strokes and generous negative space. This concept should immediately read as a capable terminal app. Permitted glyphs: > and _. Make the mark distinctive through proportion and spacing, not added decoration.
